<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <!-- Structural comments belong to the container, never to scalar content. -->
  <?native preserve="structure"?>
  <dict>
    <!-- A dictionary key may contain native CDATA text. -->
    <key><![CDATA[dock&signals]]></key>
    <!-- Comments between dictionary keys and values are valid. -->
    <dict>
      <!-- Literal and CDATA string fragments remain one native format. -->
      <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
      <string>%#@signals@<![CDATA[ near north shore]]></string>

      <!-- Comments and processing instructions between plural fields are valid. -->
      <key>signals</key>
      <dict>
        <!-- The required Foundation selector type is protected. -->
        <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
        <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
        <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
        <string>ld</string>
        <key><![CDATA[one]]></key>
        <string><![CDATA[%ld clear signal]]></string>
        <!-- Preserve this structural note while replacing only owned categories. -->
        <key>other</key>
        <string>%ld clear signals</string>
      </dict>

      <!-- Typed future metadata has strict scalar and container boundaries. -->
      <key>futureFlags</key>
      <array>
        <!-- Explicitly empty booleans are equivalent to self-closing booleans. -->
        <true></true>
        <?native preserve="array"?>
        <false/>
        <string><![CDATA[Protected <north> & steady]]></string>
        <integer>7</integer>
      </array>
      <!-- Real numbers accept CDATA even though integers, dates, and data do not. -->
      <key>futureRatio</key><real><![CDATA[1.5]]></real>
    </dict>
  </dict>
</plist>
